description: A company's greenhouse-gas emissions from its US facilities as they reported them to EPA (the Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program): direct emissions in tonnes of CO2e, the company's ownership share of them, by gas, the largest facilities, and a trend over up to five years. Scope 1 from the measurements, not a vendor's ESG score.

company.description: The parent company as its facilities name it: "Exxon", "Duke Energy", "Dow".

top.description: How many facilities to list, largest first; default 10.

trend.description: Also the total for this many years before, to the year asked for.

year.description: The reporting year; default the latest EPA has published (data for a year comes out the autumn after).

name: company_emissions

outputSchema.description: totals in metric tonnes of CO2e; facilities lists the largest with the company's share.

title: Company emissions (EPA greenhouse-gas reports)
